item.title: Mayors around the Metro: Dean O'Connor, Altoona
item.description: WHO 13 NEWS -- Dean O'Connor has been the mayor of Altoona since 2018. He joined Calyn Thompson on the Digital Desk to discuss what's most important for a growing community and to share why he continues to serve despite battling stomach cancer.

item.title: Virginia becomes first First Four team to reach Sweet Sixteen after 83-75 double-OT win over Iowa
item.description: IOWA CITY, Iowa (AP) — Kymora Johnson scored 28 points as 10th-seeded Virginia became the first First Four to reach the regional semifinals after an 83-75 double-overtime win over No. 2 seed Iowa on Monday in a women's NCAA Tournament second-round game. item.title: Rangers rookie pitcher finds out he made the team during a mound visit from manager
item.description: Carter Baumler thought he was coming out of the game. Instead, he'll be sticking around a while. The mound visit Baumler, a Dowling Catholic grad, received Monday night from Texas Rangers manager Skip Schumaker wasn't to remove the rookie right-hander from his last spring training outing, but rather to let him know he made the opening day roster.
